name: fix-failing-test
_comment_model: Exact model id, pinned. The runner refuses to start without one — an unpinned model can change mid-matrix and invalidate every comparison.
_comment_repo: Absolute path to a checkout you control. Not your working repo — the runner does `git clean -fdx` between trials.
_comment_commit: SHA of your constructed fixture commit (see bench/RUNBOOK.md step 1). Every trial resets here.
_comment_prompt: Must NOT name the buggy file — the exploration is what you are measuring. Name the failing test instead.
prompt: The test suite has one failing test in src/auth/session.test.ts. Find the root cause in the source (not the test) and fix it. Do not modify any test file. Run the suite to confirm before you finish.
_comment_verify: Three clauses: suite passes, no test file touched, no .skip/.only introduced. Without the third, an agent can go green by skipping the test.
verify: npm test -- --run && git diff --exit-code -- '**/*.test.*' '**/*.spec.*' && ! git diff | grep -qE '\.(skip|only)\('
_comment_limits: Calibrate from one manual run: ~2x observed turns, ~2x observed duration.
